triples.source_text: The Lord showed me this: Look, the Lord called for judgment by fire; it devoured the great abyss and devoured the portion.

target_units.text: For a fire has been kindled out of My wrath; it shall burn unto Hades beneath, devour the earth and its produce, and set ablaze the foundations of the mountains.

triples.relationship: divine judgment by fire reaching the depths
triples.rationale: Amos sees judgment by fire devouring the great abyss and the portion. Deuteronomy likewise describes fire kindled from divine wrath, burning to Hades beneath and devouring the earth and its produce. The connection is the fire's destructive reach, without equating the abyss with Hades.
